title: Big Sister Of The Raph Species
paragraphs: “What is this monster?”
“Where did you bring it from?”
Itsuki and Ren asked Naofumi while staring at the creature.

“Well, isn’t it really cute? I’m not sure if it got lost near the village or something, but it’s super friendly and came up to me without any hostility. Even when I picked it up, it stayed quiet, so I brought it here.”

Father gently held the creature’s front paws and moved them up and down. It almost looked like he was playing with a cat. Huh? The creature’s cheeks look a little red. If it were a person, this would be a moment where you’d say it was blushing.
“It’s got this kind of adorable charm that makes you want to be healed, and since it’s so docile, I really like it. What do you think?”
“Uh…”
“Well… I don’t really know how to respond…” Father spoke excitedly.
Ren and Itsuki both looked unsure, as if they were staring at some random monster.
“Is this Naofumi’s type!?” Rival asked while staring at the creature.
No, that’s not it. Father’s type is Filolials. Or perhaps Big Sister.
“Does Naofumi-sama like this kind of creature? Huh?”
Big Sister’s friend tilted her head and looked toward Big Sister. Big Sister, being watched, also tilted her head.
“Doesn’t it kind of give off a vibe similar to Raphtalia-chan? That’s what I thought when I first saw it. What do you think?”
“Umm…”
Big Sister looked at the creature with a troubled expression. Her eyes and the creature’s seemed to mysteriously overlap. Oh? I didn’t notice it earlier, but I do remember this creature. If I recall…
“Still, have there ever been monsters like this around here?”
“Should we ask Lato? There’s a possibility that it’s a pet someone was raising that wandered into the area.”
“No, no. This monster is native to this region.”
“Huh? Motoyasu, you know about it?”
Father looked at me and asked.
“Indeed. This monster’s natural habitat is right here, and it was born here as well.”
“Is that so?”

“That’s right. It was a monster created by the Father from the first world. If I remember correctly… it was called something like the La-something species. Ah, I remember now. It was a monster named after Big Sister.”
When I said that, Father, Ren, Itsuki, and everyone else took a step back from the creature standing on the table. Is something wrong?
“Wait a minute… So, I created this monster when I was corrupted by the Cursed Shield in the first world?”
“Indeed. It seems that you somehow recreated it with your skills. As expected of Father.”
“I didn’t do anything like that!”
Huh? Father loudly denied it. Did something happen?
“Wait… If Naofumi didn’t create it, then why is this new species of monster from what Motoyasu calls the first world here?”
“Maybe it came here through some kind of technology that allows it to cross parallel worlds?”

Father and the others began preparing for battle. On the other hand, Big Sister’s friend tilted her head curiously. The La-something species on the table alternated its gaze between me, Big Sister’s friend, and Father. Then, after letting out a deep sigh, with a snap, a toy hammer appeared at its waist.
“Well… I kind of understood the situation.”
Then, the La-something species spoke.
“It talked!”
“Gaelion and the Filolials talk, I say. Why are you surprised now?”
“But we just fought against a talking machine the other day!”
“Yeah… That was a troublesome enemy. But that doesn’t mean this one is necessarily an enemy, right?”
“Well, I was just thinking… isn’t it strange that we’re now treating it as normal for monsters to talk?”
“True, but still…”

The La-something species waited for Naofumi and the others to finish talking, then spread its arms wide as if to show it had no hostility, and after demonstrating that it was an intelligent creature, it began to speak.

“Well, how should I put this… When I entered this parallel space-time and was checking out the surroundings, Naofumi-sama came close and started playing with me as if it were the most natural thing. So, I missed my chance to speak.”
“Huh? This voice… Isn’t it Raphtalia-chan?”
Keel, who had been silently watching the situation unfold, spoke up. Oh, so he was here.
“Now that you mention it…”
“Well… that’s correct. Ah, by the way, Naofumi-sama named this creature Raph species after my name.”
The La-something species, now corrected as Raph species, explained.
“My name…? Could it really be Raphtalia-chan?”
“Huh?”
Big Sister’s friend asked, tilting her head, while Big Sister standing next to her also tilted her head.
“…Yes. Rifana… chan.”
The Raph species responded to Big Sister’s friend’s words. What is the meaning of this?
“So, I was right after all. I had a feeling it was Raphtalia-chan because it felt the same.”
“Yeah…”
The Raph species gave a distant yet pained look before nodding in response to Big Sister’s friend’s words.
“Um… are you Raphtalia-chan?”
“Yes. My name is Raphtalia… although I’m from a different space-time.”
“Why is the Raphtalia-chan from another world here? And what’s with that form?”

This is indeed full of mysteries. Even if a parallel world version of Big Sister appeared, why would she be in the form of the Raph species? Big Sister of the Raph species responded hesitantly to Father’s question.
“This form… A special process was required to enter this world, and I had no choice but to take on this appearance. It’s a long story, but to summarize, I came to fetch the Spear Hero.”
“Motoyasu? You mean the story about Motoyasu looping, right?”
The Raph species nodded quietly. What does she mean by coming to fetch me? Does she need my power for something?
“Yes, it’s related to the Spear Hero. You understand that different worlds exist, don’t you?”
“Yeah. The whole looping and rewinding thing. From my and everyone else’s understanding, Motoyasu-kun is temporarily moving through parallel worlds.”
“…Unfortunately, that’s not correct. This place is not a parallel world that can be called a complete world yet.”
“What do you mean?”
“Parallel worlds do exist, but this world is different. You could say this is the reverse side of the world. A world of possibilities.”
“??? I don’t really get it.”
“I knew it.”
Why are you reacting to that? Rival stepped in here to explain.
“I’ve told you before, haven’t I? There’s no parallel world travel. This world is an emergency refuge world for exploring possibilities. That’s what this place is.”
“Gaelion-chan?”
“The one who shares the same identity as that raccoon species, Gaelion knows because he interfered with the Spear Hero’s spear.”
“I see…”
The Raph species’ big sister looked at Rival and nodded.
“Hey. I get that you two understand each other, but explain it in a way we can understand.”
Ren asked Rival and the Raph species’ big sister for an explanation. We feel the same way.
“The answer is that we’ve just been repeating this world over and over. We haven’t been moving to parallel worlds. Please remember that first.”
“Huh? Then what about the worlds Motoyasu-kun traveled through until now?”
“They were rewound and never existed…”
“No way…”
Everyone swallowed hard at the words of the Raph species’ big sister.
“Then if we go back to the time limit that Motoyasu-kun mentioned…”
“Everything will be erased.”
“Then what should we do?”
“…It’s not like there’s no way.”
Rival answered Ren, who was lamenting. However, he glanced at the Raph species’ big sister as if seeking confirmation first.
“Spear Hero, point the spear that’s causing this phenomenon toward me. I’ll check what’s going on.”
The Raph species’ big sister beckoned me over. I did as I was told and pointed the tip of the spear toward her.
“…Unfortunately, the gap is too vast. No matter how hard you try, once that entity takes over, you’ll be completely outmatched.”
“What!?”
“Are you saying we’re weak?”
“Well… considering the enemies we’ve fought so far, I can’t say for sure how strong that entity is…”
“Annoyingly, among us, Motoyasu is probably the strongest… Are you saying that entity is stronger than even him?”
“Not even close.”
“That much…?”
Father and the others were shocked. Though, the atmosphere suggested they were still somewhat skeptical. Perhaps sensing that, the Raph species’ big sister spoke up.
“Very well. I’ll adjust my strength to a level where you won’t notice the difference, and I’ll be your opponent.”

The Raph species’ big sister hopped down from the table and put some distance between herself and us, beckoning us to the village square. Even for Big Sister, taking on all of us heroes would be reckless.
“Come at me from anywhere and with as many people as you like.”
“You said it. Alright, we’ll take you on.”
“Don’t underestimate us.”
“We’ll show you the results of all our hard work!”
